content:
Grouping by the four interface-standard lines in TECHNICAL DATA; FC-PI-4 naming maps 100/200/400/800 to 1G/2G/4G/8G FC (1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 8.5 Gbps). Transmit wavelength 1270–1355 applies to all modes in Transmitter data. No penalties in the input. Omitting 0.6, 0.614, and 8.0 Gbps — no row-level pairing to a standards code.
